pages.quiz:
INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — TERMLY EXAM #16 (TERM 1)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which action shows attentive listening? (1 mark)
   A. Looking out of the window
   B. Looking at the speaker and staying quiet
   C. Talking to a friend
   D. Drawing on your desk

2. What is the difference between hearing and listening? (1 mark)
   A. Hearing is only for adults
   B. Listening is done on purpose and hearing happens by itself
   C. Hearing needs effort but listening does not
   D. They are exactly the same

3. Singular means (1 mark)
   A. one
   B. many
   C. half
   D. none

4. What is the plural of the English word cup? (1 mark)
   A. cuppies
   B. cupes
   C. cup's
   D. cups

5. Which is a clue that a noun is plural? (1 mark)
   A. The word the
   B. A capital letter
   C. A full stop
   D. A number word such as three before it

6. Which sentence has a plural noun? (1 mark)
   A. Mother buys a banana.
   B. Mother buys one mango.
   C. Mother buys three bananas.
   D. Mother buys sugar.

7. Why should you not rush the last lines of a page? (1 mark)
   A. It is not allowed
   B. The page will run away
   C. The pen will break
   D. Neatness can be lost when you hurry

8. How should you sit when you write? (1 mark)
   A. With your back turned
   B. Lying on the desk
   C. Straight, with your book in front of you
   D. Standing on the chair

9. Which sentence gives information but not an instruction? (1 mark)
   A. Stay indoors.
   B. Bring the clothes.
   C. Close the window.
   D. Today the sky is cloudy.

10. Which game teaches that messages can change when passed on? (1 mark)
   A. Football
   B. Skipping
   C. Hide and seek only
   D. Chinese whisper

11. A newsreader on the radio should speak (1 mark)
   A. with no pauses
   B. clearly and at a steady pace
   C. very fast
   D. in a whisper

12. What is reader's theatre? (1 mark)
   A. Acting with costumes only
   B. Reading a script aloud with different parts
   C. A reading test
   D. A drawing lesson

13. Which word needs a capital letter? (1 mark)
   A. market
   B. Nairobi
   C. road
   D. river

14. What is wrong with: it rained all night. (1 mark)
   A. It needs a capital letter at the start
   B. It needs no changes
   C. It needs a comma after it
   D. It needs two full stops

15. What should you do if you did not hear a question? (1 mark)
   A. Laugh
   B. Leave
   C. Politely ask for it to be repeated
   D. Guess loudly

16. Which is a verb in: The pot tipped over? (1 mark)
   A. pot
   B. tipped
   C. The
   D. over

17. How do you show a question when reading aloud? (1 mark)
   A. Whisper
   B. Read it faster
   C. Stop reading
   D. Raise your voice at the end

18. What should you do when a stranger offers you a lift? (1 mark)
   A. Say no politely and tell a trusted adult
   B. Go with them
   C. Give your name
   D. Accept sweets

19. Which sentence should come first when making tea? (1 mark)
   A. Finally, serve the tea.
   B. Next, drink it.
   C. Then pour the milk.
   D. First, boil the water.

20. Which word shows the last step in a sequence? (1 mark)
   A. Begin
   B. First
   C. Finally
   D. Next

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Read: Mama Wanjiru buys tomatoes, an onion and three cabbages at the market. List the nouns and say which are singular and which are plural. (5 marks)

22. Write a short paragraph of three sentences about why we should write neatly. Check your capital letters and full stops. (5 marks)

23. Explain what intonation is and give one English example of a rising voice. (2 marks)

24. Write the plural of each English noun: plate, tomato. (2 marks)

25. Read: Millet porridge is a warm drink made by mixing millet flour with water and boiling it. What is it made from and how is it cooked? (3 marks)

26. Describe how you would play Simon says with your class and say what it teaches. (5 marks)

27. Explain how to work out the meaning of an unknown word using context. (4 marks)

28. Describe how a group can read a text aloud together and give feedback. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — TERMLY EXAM #16 (TERM 1) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — Looking at the speaker and staying quiet
   Attentive listening means giving your eyes, ears and mind to the speaker.

2. B — Listening is done on purpose and hearing happens by itself
   Hearing happens naturally, but listening is a choice to pay attention.

3. A — one
   A singular noun names one person, animal, place or thing.

4. D — cups
   Most English nouns add s to make the plural.

5. D — A number word such as three before it
   Number words show how many there are.

6. C — Mother buys three bananas.
   Bananas is plural, and the number three shows there are more than one.

7. D — Neatness can be lost when you hurry
   Careful writing should stay the same to the end.

8. C — Straight, with your book in front of you
   Good posture helps neat writing.

9. D — Today the sky is cloudy.
   It only tells about the weather.

10. D — Chinese whisper
   In Chinese whisper the message changes as it passes.

11. B — clearly and at a steady pace
   News should be clear and easy to follow.

12. B — Reading a script aloud with different parts
   Pupils read parts with expression.

13. B — Nairobi
   Names of towns begin with capital letters.

14. A — It needs a capital letter at the start
   The first word of a sentence must begin with a capital letter.

15. C — Politely ask for it to be repeated
   Asking politely helps you answer correctly.

16. B — tipped
   Tipped shows what the pot did.

17. D — Raise your voice at the end
   Questions often rise at the end.

18. A — Say no politely and tell a trusted adult
   Personal safety means not going with strangers.

19. D — First, boil the water.
   Boiling water is the first step.

20. C — Finally
   Finally is used for the last step.

SECTION B
----
21. (5 marks)
   Answer: Nouns: Mama Wanjiru, tomatoes, onion, cabbages, market. Singular: Mama Wanjiru, onion, market. Plural: tomatoes, cabbages.
   Working / marking points: One mark for finding all five nouns, two marks for correct singular nouns and two marks for correct plural nouns.

22. (5 marks)
   Answer: Any three neat, complete sentences, for example Neat writing helps others to read my work. It shows respect for the reader. I feel proud when my book is tidy.
   Working / marking points: One mark for each correct sentence, one mark for capital letters and one for full stops.

23. (2 marks)
   Answer: Intonation is the rise and fall of the voice as we speak. A question such as Are you coming? rises at the end.
   Working / marking points: One mark for the meaning and one mark for a correct example.

24. (2 marks)
   Answer: plates, tomatoes
   Working / marking points: One mark for each correct plural.

25. (3 marks)
   Answer: It is made from millet flour and water and it is cooked by boiling.
   Working / marking points: One mark for millet flour, one for water, one for boiling.

26. (5 marks)
   Answer: One pupil is the leader. The leader gives instructions. Pupils obey only when the leader says Simon says. Those who obey a wrong instruction are out. The game teaches careful listening.
   Working / marking points: One mark for the leader, one for the rule, one for what happens when a player breaks the rule, and two marks for explaining what it teaches.

27. (4 marks)
   Answer: Read the sentence with the word, look at nearby words for clues, guess a meaning, check that it makes sense in the sentence and confirm in a dictionary.
   Working / marking points: One mark for each of four steps.

28. (4 marks)
   Answer: Read silently first, help each other with hard words, take turns to read, then listen to the group and give one good point and one point to improve in a kind way.
   Working / marking points: One mark for each of four correct parts.
